name: Map chapter: drive in, region title, pins
when: A chapter about one region of Leonida starts. A car drives a real road into the region with a mileage counter (optional), the camera pushes in, the world outside goes quiet, the region's outline draws in its colour while its name rises, a postcard slides in; then the camera dives into the city and up to three places the game has shown pin in with their real-world names. At every chapter that moves to a region (a series: the same variant each time), never for a passing mention.
anchor: The title letters rise at `title_at` (4.12 s after a route, 0.6 s or more without one): put it on the region's name. Each pin lands at its `pinN_time`: put it on the place's name. The title leaves at `title_out`.

vars.theme: clean or vice: the video's theme
vars.region: the region, by id: vice-city, leonida-keys, grassrivers or ambrosia (gta-map/maps/regions.json). Port Gellhorn and Mount Kalaga are north of our map: no map chapter for them
vars.route: the road driven into the region, by id (`<from>-to-<to>`, both directions: leonida-keys-to-vice-city, vice-city-to-grassrivers, vice-city-to-ambrosia, grassrivers-to-ambrosia and their reverses); empty = no drive, the scene opens on the push into the region. Pick one that ends in `region`
vars.title: the title, in capitals as validated ("VICE CITY"); 13 characters at most; empty = the region's name
vars.sub: the line under the title, typed one character a frame, in spaced capitals as validated ("THE SUN AND FUN CAPITAL OF AMERICA"); 38 characters at most; empty = none
vars.postcard: a still of the region for the postcard, e.g. "@frame QdBZY2fkU-0 13.0" (the validated one: Trailer 1 at 13.0 s); empty = no postcard
vars.caption: the postcard's handwritten line; empty = "Greetings from <the region's name>"
vars.map: leave empty: the state map the skill ships (gta-map/maps/leonida.jpg). The region data is in its pixels
vars.detail: leave empty: the Vice City close-up the skill ships (gta-map/maps/vice-city.jpg). It fades in under the pins when every pin is on it
vars.title_at: seconds after the start: when the title letters start rising, on the region's name. With a route, 4.12 or more (the drive takes the first 3.4 s); without one, 0.6 or more. Everything in the title phase moves with it
vars.title_out: seconds after the start: when the title, the postcard and the region's colour leave (at least `title_at` + 0.8; validated 4.03 s after `title_at`). Without pins, it is moved earlier if the scene ends before `title_out` + 0.45
vars.pin1: a place's name as the game writes it, in capitals ("VC PORT"); 16 characters at most; empty = no pin. Only places the game has shown: gta-map/maps/regions.json `places`
vars.pin1_real: the line under it, in spaced capitals as validated ("REAL: PORT MIAMI"); empty = none
vars.pin1_icon: anchor, cup, palm, star, plane or car
vars.pin1_at: where it is: "lat,lon" of its real-world twin ("25.7745,-80.1700"); `node skills/gta-map/places.mjs` lists them
vars.pin1_time: seconds after the start: when the pin lands, on the place's name; 1.2 s or more apart, and 1.65 s or more after `title_out`, once the camera has dived in (validated 9.95, 11.15, 12.35)
vars.pin1_photo: a still of the place above the pin, e.g. "@frame QdBZY2fkU-0 24.0"; empty = none
vars.pin1_low: true = the label sits under the pin instead of above it (the validated VC PORT), when two labels would touch
vars.out: the scene's end, in seconds (the builder sets it from the plan's `end`). As validated, nothing leaves at the end: the chapter cuts to the next shot on the pins (or on the map without pins). The camera keeps pushing until then

source: algrow-gta-pipeline/mapdemo/compositions/mapvc.html (render out/mapchapter_v2.mp4), with the title block TITLE_STYLE "E" (validated as titre07-E)
changed: The title is titre07-E's look (no accent bar, the line moved up to 262 px) instead of the render's original bar. The postcard and the region's colour leave in 0.3 s instead of 0.34 / 0.35 s and the close-up map fades in over 0.5 s instead of 0.55 s (entry 0.5 s, exit 0.3 s at most); starts, eases and order are unchanged. Each pin's ring stays hidden until its pin lands (the render showed the rings from the first frame). The region, route, pins and times are values; other regions and routes come from gta-map/maps/regions.json with cameras framed the same way (kept on the map), and line widths scaled so they keep their validated size on screen. The credit chip in the corner is gone: the credit goes in the video description. Vice: plum dims, gradient title, labels and frames, ink boxes, a gradient route, nothing white. The chip's arrow (clean) is an SVG drawn like the render's, and its label line has the render's measured height, because HyperFrames' Inter has no arrow and each machine drew it from its own fallback font.
